samples.excerpt: Президент Российской Федерации Владимир Путин дал интервью телеканалу «Россия 24». Решение миграционной проблемы должно быть найдено и в интересах Белоруссии, и в интересах европейских стран. Нас все пытаются подвигнуть к исполнению Минских соглашений.
samples.english: President Vladimir Putin gave an interview to Rossiya 24. A solution to the migration problem should be found in the interests of Belarus and in the interests of the European countries. Everyone tries to push Russia to carry out the Minsk agreements. The post continues past this excerpt.

samples.excerpt: Vladimir Putin had a telephone conversation with French President Emmanuel Macron. Particular attention was paid to the internal Ukrainian conflict. Vladimir Putin drew attention to the provocative actions of Kiev, which is deliberately exacerbating the situation along the line of contact.
samples.english: Vladimir Putin spoke by phone with Emmanuel Macron. They paid particular attention to the conflict inside Ukraine. Putin pointed to actions by Kyiv along the line of contact. The post on the English channel continues past this excerpt.
